answer_twi: Farm budget yɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkyerɛ sika a wohwɛ kwan sɛ wobɛnya ne nea wobɛbɔ wɔ farming adwuma anaa season bi ho.

question_en: Why should I review a farm budget after the season?
answer_en: Comparing planned and actual figures helps you understand what went well, what went wrong and how to improve the next season.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ farm budget no bio bere a season no awie?
answer_twi: Sɛ wototo nea wosusuw ho ne nea ɛbaa ankasa a, ɛma wuhu nea ɛyɛɛ yie, nea ɛkɔɔ bɔne ne nea wubetumi asesa season foforo.

question_en: How can I decide whether to expand my farm?
answer_en: Expand only when markets, working capital, management capacity, labour, land and production records show that the enterprise can support growth.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ metrɛw m'afuo mu?
answer_twi: Trɛw no bere a gua, working capital, management, adwumayɛfo, asase ne production records kyerɛ sɛ adwuma no tumi gyina growth no so nkutoo.

question_en: Why should harvested vegetables not be left in direct sun?
answer_en: Direct heat can increase water loss and shorten shelf life. Move produce to shade and keep it cool after harvest.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ɛnsɛ sɛ mede nnɔbae a magye no gyaw owia tee mu?
answer_twi: Owia hyew ma nsuo firi nnɔbae mu ntɛm na ɛtew shelf life so. Fa wɔn kɔ sunsuma na ma wɔyɛ nwunu bere a wogye wɔn akyi.

question_en: How can I reduce bruising during produce transport?
answer_en: Use suitable containers, avoid excessive stacking and handle produce gently during loading and unloading.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn ate mpirapira so bere a merekɔfa nnɔbae?
answer_twi: Fa containers a ɛfata, mma wɔn nsi so dodo na fa ahwɛyiye di dwuma bere a woreload ne unload.

question_en: Why should storage rooms be cleaned before new grain is stored?
answer_en: Cleaning removes old residues, insects and mould sources that could affect the new grain.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhohoro guina dan ansa na wɔde aburow foforo hyɛ mu?
answer_twi: Ahotew yi nneɛma dedaw, mmoawa ne mould fibea a ɛbɛtumi akɔ new grain no so.

question_en: How can I tell if stored grain may have a mould problem?
answer_en: Look for visible mould, unusual smell, clumping, discolouration or increased moisture. Suspect grain should be isolated and assessed.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ mould wɔ aburow a meguina mu?
answer_twi: Hwɛ mould a ɛda adi, hua a ɛnsɛ, grain a ɛbata bom, kɔla a ɛsakra anaa nsuo dodo. Grain a wohwɛ sɛ ɔhaw wɔ ho no yi fi foforo no ho na hwɛ no.

question_en: Why should different grades of produce be separated?
answer_en: Separating grades helps maintain quality, improves presentation and prevents damaged produce from reducing the value of good produce.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛkyekyɛ nnɔbae no grades mu?
answer_twi: Ɛboa ma quality tena hɔ, ma presentation yɛ papa na ɛmma nnɔbae a asɛe no ntew pa no boɔ so.

question_en: How can I choose containers that protect tomatoes during transport?
answer_en: Harvest at suitable maturity, use rigid ventilated containers, avoid overloading and protect the produce from excessive heat.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn apaw containers a ɛbɔ tomatoes ho ban bere a merekɔtɔn?
answer_twi: Gye tomato bere a ɛfata, fa rigid containers a mframa tumi fa mu, mma ɛmmɔ mu dodo na bɔ wɔn ho ban fi ɔhyew den ho.

question_en: Why is clean water important when washing food crops?
answer_en: Dirty water can contaminate produce. Use water that is suitable for the intended washing purpose and keep washing equipment clean.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na nsuo a ɛho tew ho hia bere a yɛhohorɔ nnɔbae?
answer_twi: Nsuo a ɛfĩ tumi de nneɛma bɔne kɔ nnɔbae so. Fa nsuo a ɛfata aduan ho tebea di dwuma na ma washing equipment no ho tew.

question_en: How should farm produce be packaged for market?
answer_en: Use clean, suitable packaging that protects the product from crushing, contamination and excess moisture.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn apakɛ nnɔbae ama gua?
answer_twi: Fa packaging a ɛho tew na ɛfata a ɛbɔ nnɔbae ho ban fi mpirapira, fĩ ne nsuo dodo ho.

question_en: Why is traceability useful on a farm?
answer_en: Simple records can help identify where produce came from, how it was produced and where it was sold if a quality problem occurs.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na traceability ho wɔ mfasoɔ wɔ afuo so?
answer_twi: Kyerɛwtohɔ ketewa tumi boa ma wohu baabi a nnɔbae no firi, sɛnea wɔyɛe no ne baabi a wɔtɔn no sɛ quality haw bi ba a.

question_en: What should I do with damaged produce after harvest?
answer_en: Separate it from sound produce and decide whether it can be safely processed, fed to livestock where appropriate, composted or discarded.
question_twi: Dɛn na mɛyɛ wɔ nnɔbae a apira akyi a magye no?
answer_twi: Yi no fi nnɔbae pa no ho na hwɛ sɛ wobetumi ayɛ no processed food a ahobammɔ wɔ ho, ama mmoa adi sɛ ɛfata, ayɛ compost anaa ayi afi hɔ.

question_en: How can farmers prepare for a late rainy season?
answer_en: Monitor local weather information, choose suitable planting dates and varieties, conserve soil moisture and avoid planting too early into dry soil.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn asiesie m'akuayɛ ma osu bere no akyɛ?
answer_twi: Hwɛ local weather nsɛm, paw bere ne variety a ɛfata, kora nsuo wɔ asase mu na mma wofiri ase dua ntɛm wɔ asase a ɛda so yɛ kusuu mu.

question_en: What is drought-tolerant farming?
answer_en: It is an approach that reduces crop losses under limited water by using suitable varieties, moisture conservation, efficient watering and good soil management.
question_twi: Dɛn ne drought-tolerant kuayɛ?
answer_twi: Ɛyɛ kuayɛ kwan a ɛboa tew nnɔbae asɛe so bere a nsuo sua, fa varieties a ɛfata, nsuo conservation, nsuo a wɔde di dwuma yie ne asase nhwɛsoɔ pa.

question_en: How can mulch help during drought?
answer_en: Mulch reduces evaporation, protects the soil surface and can help conserve moisture around crop roots.
question_twi: Sɛn na mulch betumi aboa bere a ɔpɛ wɔ hɔ?
answer_twi: Mulch tew nsuo a ɛyera so, bɔ asase anim ho ban na ɛboa ma nsuo tena nnɔbae ntini ho.

question_en: How can farmers prepare for floods?
answer_en: Avoid planting in high-risk low areas where possible, improve drainage, protect soil structure and have a plan for moving inputs and livestock to safer areas.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn asiesie m'afuo ama nsuyiri?
answer_twi: Mma wotɔ nnɔbae wɔ mmeae a nsuyiri taa ba sɛ wubetumi akwati, siesie drainage, bɔ asase structure ho ban na nya plan sɛnea wobɛfa nneɛma ne mmoa akɔ baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ.

question_en: Why is crop diversity useful under climate uncertainty?
answer_en: Different crops respond differently to weather conditions, so diversification can reduce the risk of losing all farm income from one weather event.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na nnɔbae ahorow ho hia bere a ewim tebea nsakra?
answer_twi: Nnɔbae ahorow yɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ weather ho, enti nneɛma ahorow tew ho kwan a weather event ba a wo sika nyinaa bɛyera wɔ nnɔbae baako mu.

question_en: How can trees support a farm?
answer_en: Trees can provide shade, wind protection, organic matter and products such as fruit or timber, while suitable agroforestry can improve farm resilience.
question_twi: Sɛn na nnua betumi aboa afuo?
answer_twi: Nnua tumi ma sunsuma, bɔ mframa ho ban, ma organic matter na ma fruit anaa timber, na agroforestry a ɛfata tumi ma afuo no nya ahoɔden bere tenten.

question_en: Why should farmers maintain soil cover?
answer_en: Soil cover reduces erosion, limits moisture loss and protects soil from intense rainfall and heat.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ akuafoɔ ma asase no kata?
answer_twi: Asase a covered no tew erosion so, tew nsuo yera so na bɔ asase no ho ban fi osu den ne ɔhyew ho.

question_en: How can water harvesting support dry-season farming?
answer_en: Stored water can supplement irrigation during dry periods when designed and managed safely.
question_twi: Sɛn na nsuo a yɛboaboa ano betumi aboa ɔpɛ bere kuayɛ?
answer_twi: Nsuo a wɔakora no tumi boa irrigation wɔ ɔpɛ bere mu sɛ wɔayɛ no yie na wɔhwɛ so wɔ ahobammɔ mu.

question_en: What is the benefit of planting windbreaks?
answer_en: Windbreaks can reduce wind speed, protect crops from wind damage and reduce moisture loss.
question_twi: Mfasoɔ bɛn na windbreak wɔ?
answer_twi: Windbreak tew mframa ahoɔden so, bɔ nnɔbae ho ban fi mframa sɛe ho na tew nsuo yera so.

question_en: Why should farmers keep weather and planting records?
answer_en: Records help farmers compare seasons, understand rainfall patterns and improve planting and management decisions.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ akuafoɔ kyerɛw weather ne planting dates?
answer_twi: Records boa ma akuafoɔ toto seasons ho, te rainfall patterns ase na yɛ planting ne farm management gyina nsɛm a wɔakora so so.

question_en: What farm records should a beginner start with?
answer_en: Start with crop area, planting date, seed used, major inputs, labour, harvest quantity, sales and major expenses.
question_twi: Farm records bɛn na beginner okuafoɔ ɛsɛ sɛ ofi ase de?
answer_twi: Fi crop area, da a wotɔɔ, aba a wode dii dwuma, inputs titiriw, adwumayɛfo, harvest dodow, tɔn ne sika a wode yɛ adwuma ase.

question_en: Why should I record planting dates?
answer_en: Planting dates help you track crop duration, compare seasons and plan future farm activities.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw planting dates?
answer_twi: Planting dates boa ma wohu nna a nnɔbae no de nyin, toto seasons ho na siesie farm adwuma a ɛbɛba no.

question_en: How can a farmer calculate yield per acre?
answer_en: Divide the total marketable harvest from the plot by the plot area measured in acres, using consistent units.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn abu yield wɔ acre baako so?
answer_twi: Kyɛ harvest a wotɔn no nyinaa wɔ plot no so mu acre dodow a plot no yɛ, na fa unit koro di dwuma bere nyinaa.

question_en: Why should I record crop failures?
answer_en: Recording failures helps identify repeated problems such as pests, poor timing, drought, disease or unsuitable varieties.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw nnɔbae a wɔsɛe?
answer_twi: Ɛboa ma wohu ɔhaw a ɛsan ba bio te sɛ mmoawa, bere a woplant no, ɔpɛ, yare anaa variety a ɛnsɛ.

question_en: How can I measure whether a new farming practice has improved my farm?
answer_en: Compare the new practice with your previous method using records such as yield, input cost, labour time, crop losses and income. Review the results over more than one season where possible.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ kuayɛ kwan foforo bi ama m'afuo ayɛ yie?
answer_twi: Fa records toto kwan foforo no ne nea wode dii kan ho wɔ yield, input cost, adwuma bere, nnɔbae asɛe ne sika mu. Sɛ ɛbɛtumi a, hwɛ season bɔ nnidisoɔ so bɛyɛ baako pɛ a.

question_en: When should I seek professional agricultural advice?
answer_en: Seek help when a problem is severe, spreading quickly, difficult to identify, or involves animals, chemicals or food safety.
question_twi: Bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mepaw agricultural advice a efi ɔbenfoɔ hɔ?
answer_twi: Bisa mmoa bere a ɔhaw no yɛ kɛse, trɛw ntɛm, ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛte aseɛ, anaa ɛfa mmoa, chemicals anaa food safety ho.

question_en: Why are farmer field demonstrations useful?
answer_en: Demonstrations allow farmers to see a practice under local conditions and compare results with familiar methods.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na farmer field demonstration wɔ mfasoɔ?
answer_twi: Ɛma akuafoɔ hu kuayɛ kwan bi wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ankasa mu na wɔtumi toto ne nea wɔnim dedaw no ho.

question_en: How can farmer groups help with information sharing?
answer_en: Groups can share market information, labour, equipment, experiences, training opportunities and links to extension services.
question_twi: Sɛn na farmer groups betumi aboa wɔ nsɛm kyɛmu mu?
answer_twi: Kuo tumi kyɛ market nsɛm, adwumayɛfo, equipment, osuahu, training opportunities ne kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya extension services.

question_en: What makes a good farm record book?
answer_en: It should be simple, consistent, easy to update and organized so costs, activities, production and sales can be found quickly.
question_twi: Dɛn na ɛma farm record book yɛ papa?
answer_twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛ, ɛyɛ pɛ daa, ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wode nsɛm foforo hyɛ mu na costs, adwuma, production ne sales nya ntɛm.

question_en: How can I use last season's farm records to plan the next season?
answer_en: Update them as activities happen rather than waiting until the end of the season. Frequent records are more accurate and useful.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn de last season farm records asiesie season foforo?
answer_twi: Kyerɛw records no bere a adwuma no rekɔ so, na mma ntwɛn season no awie. Records a wɔkyerɛw daa yɛ nokware na wɔboa paa.

question_en: Why is spacing important in oil palm plantations?
answer_en: Adequate spacing reduces overcrowding, allows better light and airflow, and gives each palm enough growing space.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na plant spacing ho hia wɔ oil palm afuo mu?
answer_twi: Ntam a ɛfata tew overcrowding so, ma owia ne mframa kɔ mu yie na ɛma palm biara nya beae a ɛsɛ.

question_en: How should young oil palms be protected from weeds?
answer_en: Keep a manageable weed-free area around young palms while avoiding damage to the roots or stem.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn abɔ oil palm nketewa ho ban fi nwura ho?
answer_twi: Ma beae a ɛbɛn palm nketewa no nyɛ nwura, nanso hwɛ sɛ nwura yiyie no renyɛ ntini anaa dua no ho haw.

question_en: Why should oil palm bunches be harvested on time?
answer_en: Timely harvesting helps maintain fruit quality and reduces losses from overripe or fallen bunches.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛgye oil palm bunches bere a ɛsɛ?
answer_twi: Gyeɛ a ɛba bere mu ma fruit quality yɛ papa na ɛtew asɛe a ɛfiri bunch a wɔawie dodo anaa aba a atɔ fam ho so.

question_en: How can coconut farmers reduce damage from strong winds?
answer_en: Maintain healthy trees, manage the farm so windbreaks are possible and remove dangerous dead material safely.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn ate mframa den sɛe so wɔ coconut mu?
answer_twi: Ma nnua no nya ahoɔden, yɛ windbreak sɛ ɛfata na yi nneɛma a awu a ɛyɛ ahobammɔ ho haw no wɔ kwan a ɛyɛ safe.

question_en: What soil conditions suit coconut farming?
answer_en: Coconut generally performs best in deep soils with good drainage, adequate moisture and suitable fertility.
question_twi: Asase tebea bɛn na ɛfata coconut kuayɛ?
answer_twi: Coconut nyin yie wɔ asase a ɛdɔ, nsuo firi mu yie, nsuo wɔ mu kakra na nutrients wɔ mu a ɛfata.

question_en: How can I improve young coconut seedling survival?
answer_en: Plant healthy seedlings when soil moisture is adequate, protect them from weeds and severe heat, and maintain appropriate moisture.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn ama coconut seedlings nketewa atena ase yie?
answer_twi: Dua seedlings a wɔyɛ ahoɔden bere a nsuo wɔ asase mu, bɔ wɔn ho ban fi nwura ne ɔhyew den ho na ma moisture a ɛfata.

question_en: Why is farm sanitation important around oil palms?
answer_en: Removing or properly managing dead and decaying material can reduce some pest and disease risks and make inspection easier.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na farm sanitation ho hia wɔ oil palm ho?
answer_twi: Sɛ wuyi anaa wohwɛ nneɛma a awu ne nea ɛporɔ yie a, ebetumi ate mmoawa ne yare ho haw so na ɛma inspection yɛ mmerɛ.

question_en: How can coconut husks be used on the farm?
answer_en: Husks can be used as mulch or processed for fibre and other products, depending on local facilities and demand.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn de coconut husks adi dwuma wɔ afuo mu?
answer_twi: Wobetumi de husks ayɛ mulch anaa ayɛ fibre ne nneɛma foforo sɛ mpɔtam no wɔ facilities ne gua a ɛfata.

question_en: What should I consider before starting a tree-crop farm?
answer_en: Consider the long establishment period, land rights, capital, market, labour, climate and when income is expected to begin.
question_twi: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusuw ho ansa na mahyɛ tree-crop kuayɛ ase?
answer_twi: Susuw bere tenten a nnua no de bɛyɛ, asase ho hokwan, capital, gua, adwumayɛ, ewim tebea ne bere a wobɛfi ase anya sika ho.

question_en: Why are tree crops different from annual crops in business planning?
answer_en: Tree crops may require substantial investment before reaching full production, so the farmer needs longer-term cash-flow planning.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na tree crops yɛ soronko fi annual crops ho wɔ business planning mu?
answer_twi: Tree crops tumi hia sika pii ansa na wɔafi ase bɔ aba pii, enti okuafoɔ hia cash-flow nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ ma daakye tenten.

question_en: How can I select healthy plantain suckers?
answer_en: Choose vigorous, disease-free planting material from healthy mother plants and avoid suckers showing unusual damage or weakness.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn apaw plantain suckers a wɔyɛ ahoɔden?
answer_twi: Paw planting material a ɛyɛ ahoɔden na yare nni ho, na ɛfiri mother plants a ɛyɛ sehat. Mfa suckers a asɛe anaa ayɛ mmerɛ.

question_en: Why should plantain fields have good drainage?
answer_en: Waterlogging can weaken roots and increase disease problems, while well-drained soil supports healthy growth.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na plantain afuo hia drainage pa?
answer_twi: Nsuo a ɛgyina asase mu tew ntini no ahoɔden so na ɛma yare dɔɔso, bere a asase a nsuo firi mu yie boa nyin.

question_en: How can I reduce wind damage in plantain?
answer_en: Use suitable spacing, maintain healthy plants and consider wind protection where strong winds are common.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn ate mframa sɛe so wɔ plantain mu?
answer_twi: Fa spacing a ɛfata, ma nnua no nyɛ ahoɔden na susuw wind protection ho wɔ mmeae a mframa den taa ba.

question_en: When should I remove old plantain leaves?
answer_en: Remove dead or severely damaged leaves when necessary while avoiding excessive removal of healthy leaves.
question_twi: Bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyi plantain nhaban dedaw?
answer_twi: Yi nhaban a awu anaa asɛe dodo bere a ɛhia, nanso mfa healthy nhaban pii nyɛ saa.

question_en: Why is desuckering important in plantain?
answer_en: Managing excess suckers helps reduce overcrowding and allows the farmer to maintain the desired number of productive plants.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na desuckering ho hia wɔ plantain mu?
answer_twi: Sɛ wokora suckers a ɛdɔɔso so a, ɛte overcrowding so na ɛma okuafoɔ no hwɛ plants a ɛbɔ aba yie no dodow.

question_en: How can I protect banana bunches from physical damage?
answer_en: Use suitable bunch-management practices, avoid rough handling and keep pathways clear during field operations.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn abɔ banana bunches ho ban fi mpirapira ho?
answer_twi: Fa bunch management akwan a ɛfata, mfa ahoɔden nyɛ wɔn ho adwuma na ma akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma no ho tew.

question_en: What causes poor bunch development in plantain?
answer_en: Poor nutrition, drought stress, pests, disease, overcrowding and weak planting material can reduce bunch development.
question_twi: Dɛn na ɛma plantain bunch development yɛ bɔne?
answer_twi: Nutrition a ɛsua, ɔpɛ, mmoawa, yare, overcrowding ne planting material a ɛyɛ mmerɛ tumi tew bunch development so.

question_en: How should plantain bunches be transported?
answer_en: Handle bunches carefully, protect them from crushing and avoid unnecessary dropping during loading and transport.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn de plantain bunches akɔ gua a ɛnsɛe?
answer_twi: Kura bunches no yie, bɔ wɔn ho ban fi crushing ho na mma wɔntɔ fam bere a woreloading ne transport.

question_en: How can I choose a reliable poultry feed supplier?
answer_en: Choose a reputable supplier, check feed labels and dates, and store feed correctly after purchase.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn apaw poultry feed supplier a mewɔ ahotoso wɔ no?
answer_twi: Paw supplier a ne din ye, hwɛ feed label ne dates na guina feed no yie bere a woatɔ no.

question_en: Why should poultry feed be stored off the floor?
answer_en: Keeping feed off the floor reduces moisture, contamination and pest damage.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde poultry feed gu fam so?
answer_twi: Sɛ feed no da fam a nsuo, fĩ ne mmoawa tumi ka ho. Sɔre no fi fam tew ɔhaw yi so.

question_en: How can I reduce stress when introducing new chickens?
answer_en: Provide suitable housing, clean water, feed and a calm environment, and avoid overcrowding during the adjustment period.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn ate stress so bere a mede nkokoɔ foforo ba?
answer_twi: Ma housing a ɛfata, nsuo ne feed pa, ma beae no yɛ dwo na mma wɔn nkɔyɛ overcrowding bere a wɔresiesie wɔn ho.

question_en: Why is ventilation important in a poultry house?
answer_en: Good ventilation helps control heat, moisture, odours and air quality while reducing respiratory stress.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ventilation ho hia wɔ akokɔ fie?
answer_twi: Ventilation pa boa ma ɔhyew, nsuo, hua ne mframa quality yɛ pɛ na ɛte respiratory stress so.

question_en: How can I tell if chickens are eating normally?
answer_en: Monitor feed consumption, activity, droppings, body condition and changes in behaviour rather than relying on one sign.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ akokɔ redi aduane sɛnea ɛsɛ?
answer_twi: Hwɛ feed consumption, activity, wɔn dɔte, nipadua tebea ne suban nsakrae, na mfa nsɛnkyerɛnne baako so nko ara nnyina.

question_en: How do I select healthy fingerlings?
answer_en: Choose active fingerlings from a reliable source, with uniform size and no obvious deformities or signs of disease.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn apaw fingerlings a wɔyɛ ahoɔden?
answer_twi: Paw fingerlings a wɔyɛ active fi source a wonim, wɔn kɛse yɛ pɛ na deformity anaa yare ho nsɛnkyerɛnne nni ho.

question_en: Why should fish be stocked gradually?
answer_en: Gradual acclimatization helps fish adjust to differences in water temperature and quality and can reduce stress.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛde mpataa gu pond mu nkakrankakra?
answer_twi: Acclimatization a wɔyɛ nkakrankakra boa mpataa ma wɔfa nsakrae a ɛwɔ nsuo hyew ne quality mu no ho na ɛte stress so.

question_en: How can I prevent overcrowding in a fish pond?
answer_en: Stock according to the pond's capacity and monitor fish growth, water quality and available oxygen.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn ate mpataa dodo so wɔ pond mu?
answer_twi: Fa dodow a pond no tumi soa no gu mu na hwɛ mpataa nyin, nsuo quality ne oxygen a ɛwɔ mu.

question_en: What should I do if fish stop feeding suddenly?
answer_en: Check water quality, temperature, oxygen, recent weather, feed quality and signs of disease before increasing feed.
question_twi: Dɛn na mɛyɛ sɛ mpataa gyae di aduane ntɛm?
answer_twi: Hwɛ nsuo quality, ɔhyew, oxygen, weather a aba foforo, feed quality ne yare ho nsɛnkyerɛnne ansa na woama feed no so.

question_en: How should a fish farmer keep pond records?
answer_en: Record stocking date and number, feed used, mortalities, water-quality observations, treatments, harvest weight and sales.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛw fish pond records?
answer_twi: Kyerɛw stocking da ne dodow, feed a wode dii dwuma, mpataa a awuwu, nsuo quality nsɛm, ayaresa, harvest duru ne tɔn.

question_en: How can I provide shelter for sheep during heavy rain?
answer_en: Provide a dry, well-drained shelter with enough space for the animals to rest without crowding and keep bedding clean.
question_twi: Mɛyɛ dɛn ayɛ dabere ama nguan bere a osu den retɔ?
answer_twi: Ma nguan no dry shelter a drainage pa wɔ mu, baabi a ɛdɔɔso ma wɔtena a wɔrenhyiam dodo na ma bedding no ho tew.

question_en: Why should cattle have access to shade and clean water?
answer_en: Shade reduces heat stress while clean, reliable water supports hydration, feed intake and normal body functions.
question_twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ anantwi nya sunsuma ne nsuo pa?
answer_twi: Sunsuma te heat stress so, na nsuo pa a wɔnya daa boa hydration, aduane di ne nipadua no nnwuma a ɛfata.
